items.title: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co Ltd Stock (TSM) Moved Down by 3.31% on Jul 29: Key Drivers Unveiled
items.summary: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co Ltd (TSM) stock declined by 3.31% due to macroeconomic headwinds, particularly signals from the Federal Reserve about prolonged high interest rates, and sector-wide profit-taking. Concerns about the immediate returns on AI infrastructure investment, normalization of consumer electronics inventory, and continuous geopolitical risks also contributed to the downward pressure and volatility. Technical indicators show a sell signal, and analysts are watchful of potential weaknesses in revenue concentration and margin pressures from advanced node escalations.

items.title: Vulcan Materials Q2 Earnings & Revenues Beat Estimates, Stock Up
items.summary: Vulcan Materials Company (VMC) reported strong Q2 2026 results, surpassing earnings and revenue estimates, leading to a 2.2% stock increase in pre-market trading. The company's performance was driven by growth in aggregates volume and pricing, commercial discipline, and operational efficiencies, despite challenges from energy-related inflation and disruptive weather. VMC reaffirmed its full-year adjusted EBITDA outlook, expecting continued aggregates price growth and effective cost management.

items.title: POOL CORP Q2 2026: Revenue $1.823B, EPS $5.17— 10-Q Summary
items.summary: POOL CORP reported its Q2 2026 results with revenue reaching $1.823 billion, a 2% increase year-over-year. Net income decreased by 3% to $188.1 million, while diluted EPS remained flat at $5.17. The company's sales growth was driven by inflation and steady demand for maintenance and building materials, and it reiterated its full-year sales guidance for low single-digit growth.

items.title: Toyota Motor Corp Stock (TM) Moved Up by 3.73% on Jul 29: Drivers Behind the Movement
items.summary: Toyota Motor Corp's stock (TM) increased by 3.73% on July 29, driven by strong quarterly financial results, robust operating profit margins, and a weak Japanese Yen which boosted international revenue. The company's strategic focus on hybrid powertrains, effective cost-management, and a favorable product mix prioritizing high-margin models also contributed to its outperformance. Positive investor sentiment was further fueled by updates on solid-state battery technology and stable global supply chains, despite broader industry headwinds.

items.title: Earnings call transcript: Seven Hills Realty Trust misses Q2 2026 estimates
items.summary: Seven Hills Realty Trust reported Q2 2026 distributable earnings of $0.23 per share, missing analyst estimates of $0.26, with revenue also falling short at $8.13 million against expectations of $9.1 million. The company's stock fell 4.23% in after-hours trading, approaching its 52-week low. Management attributed the miss primarily to delayed loan closings rather than credit issues, maintaining its quarterly dividend of $0.28 per share and an unchanged year-end portfolio target.

items.title: PepsiCo Rides Global Volume Growth as North American Demand Slows
items.summary: PepsiCo is experiencing dual operating trends in 2026, with strong international volume growth driven by emerging markets, functional beverages, and permissible snacks. Conversely, North America faces moderated demand due to tighter consumer budgets, leading to a slight revenue decline and a focus on affordability and price-pack architecture. While productivity savings helped core operating profit, the company's stock currently holds a Zacks Rank #4 (Sell) due to uneven near-term conditions and unfavorable earnings-estimate trends.
